msg: Hi there. I got my SSI Open Water certification about ten years ago but I've lost my card and I've only done a handful of dives since. Can I still dive with you? I'm from Ireland and I'm travelling alone.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, you can still dive with us, and travelling alone is no problem—we’ll pair you with a buddy or include you in a guided group.

You'll also need:
• There is no theory to do beforehand: it is done there, on the day, with the instructor.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

Since you’ve only done a handful of dives and it’s been over two years, a refresher is normally required. For recreational dives and the refresher, you’ll need to present your certification card; since yours is lost, a team advisor can help look up your SSI certification in the agency’s database. Would you like me to connect you with an advisor to help with that?

msg: Yes, please do, but first could you tell me what I'd pay for the refresher? I'd be leaving from Cartagena. And is the refresher done on a different day from the normal dives?
reply:
The refresher is the Dive Mini Course, which includes a pool session with theory and confined-water practice, followed by one reef dive. From Cartagena, it runs as a day trip, so it’s done on the same day—not on a separate day from the normal dives. The schedule is 8:00 a.m. departure from Muelle de la Bodeguita, returning to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m.

I’m leaving the refresher price below. The online price includes the standard 10% online discount. Since you’re travelling from Ireland, you’d pay in USD; the COP price is also shown for reference.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

msg: It's just me, as I said. And if I do the refresher and then want two normal dives the following day, what would that come to per dive day, and how do I book both?
reply:
You’re right—you said it’s just you. Sorry about that.

The prices are per person; the online discount is applied when booking on our website. You can book the refresher and the two-dive trip separately using their respective booking links:

• Refresher (Dive Mini Course): https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en  
• Two Fun Dives: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD (1.429.000 COP · 1.587.000 COP)
• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD (1.813.000 COP · 2.015.000 COP)

One last thing so I can give you the right price and link: are you a Colombian national, or do you have a Colombian *cédula de extranjería* (Colombia's ID card for foreigners)?

msg: I'm Irish, no Colombian ID. But those are packages, I only asked about the refresher plus two normal dives the next day. How much are the two normal dives on their own?
reply:
You’re right—sorry for the confusion. The two normal dives on their own, departing from Cartagena, are *178 USD online* or *197 USD regular*, per person. The online price includes the standard 10% discount.

The two-dive trip is a same-day return from Cartagena, with the boat, equipment, lunch, park entrance fee and dive insurance included.

To give you the right link: would you prefer *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)* or *Dive Mini Course*? 🌊
